text:
morgan: FYI — customer on Dedicated (cust-123) reports an admin user 'svc-deploy' appeared in their private control plane after last week's RBAC refactor. They say their VPC allowlist didn't change. Anyone seen this pattern?

eva: @morgan can you paste the binding / subject details? svc names, kinds?

morgan: here's the `kubectl get clusterrolebinding svc-deploy-binding -o yaml` snippet:
```
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: svc-deploy
  namespace: infra
roleRef:
  kind: ClusterRole
  name: admin
```

li: sec-bot flagged a related anomaly — KMS audit entries for that project between 2026-03-12T03:05 and 03:20 are missing. We still have control-plane auth request logs.

john: Could be the rbac-sync job that applies bindings on cluster registration. If syncer had stale mapping it might have assigned the wrong subject. Check rbac-sync logs.

morgan: Pulled rbac-sync logs: `2026-03-12T03:06:12Z INFO applied binding for group 'eng-ops' -> cluster cust-123` — but that group shouldn't map to that org. Also saw `syncer: fallback to serviceaccount 'svc-deploy'` in the same window.

eva: If syncer fell back it probably read an intermediate mapping from S3. Was there a propagation/race with the mapping file write?

morgan: S3 last-write for mappings is 2026-03-12T02:55:23Z, but our RBAC refactor deploy (the one that added the new mapping) went out at ~03:00. Looks like the mapping was pushed before the secret/config propagation finished to the syncer instances.

li: That also explains the missing KMS audit: the serviceaccount used to access keys was impersonated cross-project and our KMS pipeline filters out that project by default. We need to assume possible key usage and triage.

john: Immediate mitigation proposal:
- remove clusterrolebinding `svc-deploy-binding` (morgan)
- rotate/expire tokens for `svc-deploy` and revoke active sessions (oncall)
- add an S3-etag/version gating in rbac-sync so it only applies if mapping version matches local copy (eng-platform)
- run a KMS re-audit for cust-123 keys (li)
I'll spin up an incident (P0) and page oncall.

morgan: Doing removal now — `kubectl delete clusterrolebinding svc-deploy-binding` — done. Binding gone from cluster.

oncall: Pager received, starting token revocation for svc-deploy, notifying customer, creating incident ticket.

li: KMS re-scan started for cust-123. Will flag any calls that are not in the customer's service account allowlist. ETA ~45m.

eva: Postmortem / long-term fixes:
- enforce stronger gating on rbac-sync (etag/version + signed manifest)
- add an alert when KMS events expected after control-plane auth are missing for >15m
- add an integration test that simulates S3 propagation lag + syncer restart

morgan: Assigning owners in thread: morgan (removal + customer comms), oncall (token rotation & revoke), li (kms re-audit), eva (postmortem writeup + followups).

sec-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 created by morgan. Pager duty: oncall.

john: Thanks everyone — good catch. Let's reconvene in 1h for status. :thumbsup:
